scope: Inspect the supplied Ma original and Badro main paper; compare the selected Ma formulation without changing runtime code or empirical claims.
source_storage: User-supplied PDFs are in refs. Hash URNs identify the inspected bytes; offline MCEG does not verify URI artifacts. No source PDF was modified.

ma2001.title: Thermodynamic description for concentrated metallic solutions using interaction parameters
ma2001.inspected_locations: PDF pp. 2-5, printed pp. 88-91: Sections II-III, Eqs. 10-12, 16-26 and Tables I-II. PDF pp. 15-16, printed pp. 101-102: nomenclature. Eqs. 21-26 and Tables I-II were also checked on rendered pages.
ma2001.basis: x_i is the mole fraction of element i, with component 1 the solvent. gamma_i is Raoultian on the pure-substance standard; gamma_i^0 is its infinite-dilution value. epsilon parameters use mole fractions, unlike the separate mass-percent e parameters.
ma2001.approximation: Section III considers a nonreacting solution at fixed T and P. Table II neglects second- and higher-order interaction parameters, derivatives involving three or more distinct solutes, and mixed derivatives with both powers at least three. This review concerns Eqs. 21-26, not the later higher-order extensions.

ternary_mapping.variables: s=x_Si; o=x_O; a=epsilon_SiSi; b=epsilon_OO; c=epsilon_SiO=epsilon_OSi; ls=ln(gamma_Si^0); lo=ln(gamma_O^0)
ternary_mapping.standard_shift_RT: (mu0_formal-mu0_source)/(RT)=(0,ls+a,lo+b); add this vector to formal ln_gamma to recover the source convention.
ternary_mapping.comparison: After canceling removable zero-fraction factors, Eq. 21 minus the linear standard-state terms equals MaFeSiOLiquid.gex_RT. Eq. 22 differentiates that scalar into Eqs. 23-24; their ternary forms, Eqs. 25-26, match the inspected reference generator. Pure Si/O endpoints remain formal continuations, not calibrated physical pure-substance standards.

reproduction_comparison.Vogel_A1: The five terms agree with original Eq. 23, including the ordered-pair sums.
reproduction_comparison.Buchan_Eq6: The selected solute expression agrees with original Eq. 24.
reproduction_comparison.Vogel_A2: The negative cross term prints +1/(1-x_i) inside its parentheses. Original Eqs. 24 and 26 print -1/(1-x_i), as do the selected Buchan/Young expressions. The original supports the implementation's minus sign.
reproduction_comparison.Vogel_A2_minus_original_ternary: -2*c*x_j/(1-x_i) in ln_gamma_i; not a constant standard-state shift.
reproduction_comparison.locations: Vogel accepted manuscript PDF pp. 42-43, A1-A2; Buchan arXiv v1 PDF p. 5, Eq. 6. The previously inspected source versions were retained for this comparison.

ma2001.parameter_boundary: The original establishes the equation form and conventions. It does not resolve the specific Young printed/code oxygen coefficient difference or verify Badro's supplementary calibration. No new physical applicability domain is inferred.

badro2015.title: Core formation and core composition from coupled geochemical and geophysical constraints
badro2015.inspection: Main-paper Methods and relevant Results inspected; SI Appendix not supplied.
badro2015.inspected_locations: PDF p. 2, printed p. 12311, Methods and Results and Discussion. The five-page PDF contains the main article, printed pp. 12310-12314, without a supplementary appendix or embedded files.
badro2015.finding: Methods describes 1,000 accretion/equilibration steps and sends the thermodynamic uncertainty information to SI Appendix Table S1. Results states that metal activity coefficients depend on Si and O and refers to supplementary equations and figures. This is not the requested parameter table or an original Fe-Si-O calibration replay.
badro2015.remaining: Obtain and inspect pnas.1505672112.sapp.pdf. The supplied main paper does not establish which of +16500/T and +1873/T is intended in the Young oxygen self-interaction term.

eq21_vs_reference.method: Evaluate the displayed ternary Eq. 21 with Python Decimal precision 60 and the seven fixture input states/parameters; compare against gex_source_RT returned by the unchanged reference generator's activities function (sum of x_i*ln_gamma_i from Eqs. 23-24). Subtract s*(ls+a)+o*(lo+b) and compare gex_formal_RT separately. This checks source algebra, not independent experimental data.
